passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: FINANCIAL CONDITION AND RESULTS OF OPERATIONS. OVERVIEW: PACCAR is a global technology company whose Truck segment includes the design and manufacture of high-quality light-, medium- and heavy-duty commercial trucks. In the U.S. and Canada, trucks are sold under the Kenworth and Peterbilt nameplates, in Europe, under the DAF nameplate and in Mexico, Australia and South America, under the Kenworth and DAF nameplates. The Parts segment includes the distribution of aftermarket parts for trucks and related commercial vehicles. The Company’s Financial Services segment derives its earnings primarily from financing or leasing PACCAR products in North America, Europe, Australia and South America. 2025 Financial Highlights • Worldwide net sales and revenues were $28.44 billion in 2025 compared to $33.66 billion in 2024, primarily due to lower truck revenues, partially offset by higher parts and financial services revenues. • Truck sales were $19.37 billion in 2025 compared to $24.84 billion in 2024 due to lower truck deliveries in all major markets. • Parts sales were $6.87 billion in 2025 compared to $6.67 billion in 2024, reflecting higher sales in the U.S. and Canada and Europe. • Financial Services revenues were $2.21 billion in 2025 compared to $2.10 billion in 2024, primarily due to higher interest income driven by retail portfolio growth and higher portfolio yields. • In 2025, PACCAR earned net income for the 87 th consecutive year. Net income was $2.38 billion ($4.51 per diluted share) in 2025 compared to $4.16 billion ($7.90 per diluted share) in 2024. • Adjusted net income (non-GAAP), excluding a $264.5 million after-tax charge related to civil litigation in Europe, was $2.64 billion ($5.01 per diluted share). After-tax return on beginning equity (ROE) was 13.6% in 2025, which includes the $264.5 million after-tax charge related to civil litigation in Europe in the first quarter of this year. Excluding the after-tax charge, adjusted ROE (non-GAAP) was 15.1%. This compares to an ROE of 26.2% in 2024. See Reconciliation of GAAP to Non-GAAP Financial Measures on page 31. • Capital investments were $728.5 million in 2025 compared to $795.8 million in 2024. • Research and development (R&D) expenses were $445.5 million in 2025 compared to $452.9 million in 2024. Kenworth constructed a 46,000 square-foot robotic chassis paint facility in Chillicothe, Ohio. PACCAR also completed a new $35 million, 50,000 square-foot engine remanufacturing facility and is enhancing its existing engine factory in Columbus, Mississippi. PACCAR is also enhancing its other engine facility in the Netherlands. PACCAR opened a new 180,000 square-foot Parts Distribution Center (PDC) in Calgary, Canada, to enhance parts delivery to dealers and customers in the region. The PACCAR Financial Services (PFS) group of companies has operations covering four continents and 26 countries. The global breadth of PFS and its rigorous credit application process support a portfolio of loans and leases with total assets of $22.80 billion. PACCAR Inc (the Company or PACCAR), incorporated under the laws of Delaware in 1971, is the successor to Pacific Car and Foundry Company which was incorporated in Washington in 1924. The Company traces its predecessors to Seattle Car Manufacturing Company formed in 1905. Description of Business PACCAR is a multinational company operating in three principal industry segments: (1) The Truck segment includes the design, manufacture and distribution of high-quality, light-, medium- and heavy-duty commercial trucks. Heavy-duty trucks have a gross vehicle weight (GVW) of over 33,000 lbs (Class 8) in North America and over 16 metric tonnes in Europe and South America. Medium-duty trucks have a GVW ranging from 19,500 to 33,000 lbs (Class 6 to 7) in North America, and in Europe, light- and medium-duty trucks range between 6 and 16 metric tonnes. Trucks are configured with the engine in front of cab (conventional) or cab-over-engine (COE). (2) The Parts segment includes the distribution of aftermarket parts for trucks and related commercial vehicles. (3) The Financial Services segment includes finance and leasing products and services provided to customers and dealers. PACCAR’s finance and leasing activities are principally related to PACCAR products and associated equipment. TRUCKS PACCAR’s trucks are marketed under the Kenworth, Peterbilt and DAF nameplates. These trucks, which are built in three plants in the United States, three in Europe and one each in Australia, Brasil, Canada and Mexico, are used worldwide for over-the-road and off-highway hauling of commercial and consumer goods. The Company also designs and manufactures diesel engines, primarily for use in the Company’s trucks, at its facilities in Columbus, Mississippi; Eindhoven, the Netherlands and Ponta Grossa, Brasil. credit_strengths.text: PACCAR's diversified franchise across Kenworth, Peterbilt and DAF trucks, aftermarket parts and a captive finance arm generates recurring revenue and earnings, with net income earned for many consecutive years. This breadth supports cash generation through truck cycles, as parts and financial services revenues grew even as truck sales fell.

Operating cash flow comfortably funds capital investment, leaving substantial free cash flow. Capital investments are modest relative to cash generation, so internally generated funds cover both product development and the dividend, which is a key credit strength versus more levered peers.

key_risks.text: Truck revenues fell sharply year over year on lower deliveries across all major markets, dragging operating income and margins down. The MD&A attributes the decline to weaker truck demand, and the outlook remains cyclical, so earnings could stay under pressure if freight conditions do not recover.

The borrowings note shows a large commercial paper balance maturing within the next year, alongside term notes and bank loans. This concentration requires continuous refinancing, and PACCAR issued medium-term notes to repay maturing debt, so rollover risk and funding costs are material to the captive finance segment.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is solid, with operating income covering cash interest paid multiple times, though it sits below the sector median. The borrowings note shows interest paid rose year over year as rates and balances increased, so coverage could compress if truck earnings weaken further.

Free cash flow is strong relative to cash interest paid, and the company returns significant cash to shareholders through dividends and buybacks. However, distributions absorb most free cash flow, leaving limited cushion for debt reduction, and the debt note shows sizable near-term maturities requiring refinancing.

overall_credit_view.text: PACCAR presents a strong credit profile supported by diversified operations, consistent profitability and robust cash generation. The captive finance borrowings are sizable but match a loan and lease portfolio, and interest coverage remains adequate. The main constraint is cyclical truck demand, which has weakened and could pressure earnings and coverage.

Our forward view is stable but sensitive to the truck cycle. We expect cash flow to remain sufficient for debt service, though shareholder distributions limit deleveraging. A data gap exists because debt and cash tags are missing, preventing calculation of leverage; this is material and should be confirmed from the borrowings note before finalizing the view.

credit_strengths.text: PACCAR 旗下 Kenworth、Peterbilt 及 DAF 貨車、售後零件及專屬金融業務的多元化特許經營權，產生經常性收入及盈利，並連續多年錄得淨收入。此廣度支持其於貨車週期中的現金產生能力，因零件及金融服務收入即使在貨車銷售下跌時仍有所增長。
營運現金流足以輕鬆支付資本投資，並留下大量自由現金流。資本投資相對於現金產生而言屬溫和，因此內部產生的資金足以支付產品開發及股息，此乃相對於槓桿較高的同業而言的一項關鍵信用優勢。

key_risks.text: 貨車收入按年大幅下跌，因所有主要市場的交付量減少，拖累營運收入及利潤率下降。管理層討論與分析將跌幅歸因於貨車需求疲弱，而前景仍具週期性，因此若貨運環境未能復甦，盈利可能持續受壓。
借款附註顯示大量商業票據於未來一年內到期，另有定期票據及銀行貸款。此集中度需要持續再融資，而 PACCAR 發行中期票據以償還到期債務，因此展期風險及融資成本對專屬金融業務而言屬重大。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率穩健，營運收入覆蓋現金利息支出達數倍，儘管低於行業中位數。借款附註顯示已付利息按年上升，因利率及結餘增加，因此若貨車盈利進一步轉弱，覆蓋率可能受壓。
自由現金流相對於已付現金利息而言強勁，而公司透過股息及回購向股東返還大量現金。然而，分派吸收大部分自由現金流，留下有限緩衝作減債之用，而債務附註顯示有相當規模的短期到期債務需要再融資。

overall_credit_view.text: PACCAR 呈現強勁的信用狀況，受多元化業務、持續盈利能力及穩健現金產生所支持。專屬金融借款規模可觀，但與貸款及租賃組合相匹配，而利息覆蓋率仍屬充足。主要制約在於週期性的貨車需求，該需求已轉弱，並可能對盈利及覆蓋率構成壓力。
我們的前瞻觀點為穩定，但對貨車週期敏感。我們預期現金流將仍足以償付債務，儘管股東分派限制去槓桿。存在數據缺口，因債務及現金標籤缺失，導致無法計算槓桿；此屬重大事項，應在最終確定觀點前從借款附註中確認。
